description: Fetch block trip sequences with their stop times and service-calendar conditions. Top-level fields describe the first returned configuration; every remaining alternative is included without choosing a calendar date. Optionally select an exact tripId or complete trips having any departure in a half-open GTFS-seconds interval, independently in every configuration; selection counts trip occurrences before and after filtering. Without selectors, returns all trips with no default cap. Block IDs appear as blockId in onebusaway_get_trip responses; obtain a tripId from onebusaway_get_arrivals first.

blockId.description: Block ID from a trip record. Obtain a tripId from onebusaway_get_arrivals, then call onebusaway_get_trip to get the blockId.

departureBeforeSec.description: Exclusive departure upper bound in GTFS seconds from midnight; must exceed departureFromSec when both are supplied.

departureFromSec.description: Inclusive departure lower bound in GTFS seconds from midnight; values beyond 86400 are valid.

tripId.description: Exact trip ID; omit or leave blank for no trip selector. Mutually exclusive with departure bounds.

name: onebusaway_get_block

activeServiceIds.description: Service IDs required active for the first returned configuration.

alternateConfigurations.description: Remaining configurations in upstream order; empty when none exist.

activeServiceIds.description: Service IDs required active for this configuration.

inactiveServiceIds.description: Service IDs required inactive for this configuration.

accumulatedSlackTime.description: Accumulated layover/slack time (seconds) before this trip starts.

arrivalTime.description: Arrival in GTFS seconds from midnight.

departureTime.description: Departure in GTFS seconds from midnight.

dropOffType.description: GTFS drop-off type (0=regular, 1=no dropoff, 2=phone agency, 3=coordinate with driver).

pickupType.description: GTFS pickup type (0=regular, 1=no pickup, 2=phone agency, 3=coordinate with driver).

distanceAlongBlock.description: Cumulative distance (meters) from block start to the first stop of this trip.

tripId.description: Trip ID for follow-up onebusaway_get_trip calls.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `block_not_found`: Block ID does not exist on this instance. `rate_limited`: No upstream request slot opened within the queue wait cap, or OneBusAway returned a rate limit response. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

inactiveServiceIds.description: Service IDs required inactive for the first returned configuration.

notice.description: Alternative-configuration guidance or an aggregate empty-selection notice.

selection.description: Applied selectors and aggregate trip occurrence counts across every configuration; absent without selectors.

configurationCounts.description: Preserved slot order: index 0 is the top-level first configuration; index 1 is alternateConfigurations[0], and so on, including empty slots.

items.description: Trip occurrence counts for one configuration.

departureBeforeSec.description: Exclusive departure upper bound in GTFS seconds from midnight; must exceed departureFromSec when both are supplied.

departureFromSec.description: Inclusive departure lower bound in GTFS seconds from midnight; values beyond 86400 are valid.

tripId.description: Exact trip ID; omit or leave blank for no trip selector. Mutually exclusive with departure bounds.

trips.description: All trips in the first returned configuration, in order.

accumulatedSlackTime.description: Accumulated layover/slack time (seconds) before this trip starts.

arrivalTime.description: Arrival in GTFS seconds from midnight.

departureTime.description: Departure in GTFS seconds from midnight.

dropOffType.description: GTFS drop-off type (0=regular, 1=no dropoff, 2=phone agency, 3=coordinate with driver).

pickupType.description: GTFS pickup type (0=regular, 1=no pickup, 2=phone agency, 3=coordinate with driver).

distanceAlongBlock.description: Cumulative distance (meters) from block start to the first stop of this trip.

tripId.description: Trip ID for follow-up onebusaway_get_trip calls.
